return {
	["Default"] = "SouthernPlains",
	["Get"] = function(p1) -- name: Get
		if p1 then
			p1 = script:FindFirstChild(p1)
		end
		if p1 then
			p1 = require(p1)
		end
		return p1
	end,
	["GetAll"] = function() -- name: GetAll
		local v2 = {}
		for _, v3 in script:GetChildren() do
			v2[v3.Name] = require(v3)
		end
		return v2
	end
}

		end

		if v226.skinId and v226.skinId ~= "none" then

function v_u_39.load(p_u_46) -- name: load
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_38, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_45
	local v47 = v_u_13
	assert(v47(p_u_46))
	local v_u_48 = p_u_46.storeContext
	local v_u_49 = v_u_48.logger:extend({
		["method"] = "load",

	})
	local v50 = {
		["storeContext"] = v_u_48,
		["key"] = p_u_46.key,

			["key"] = p_u_46.key
		}):andThen(function(p52)
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_51, (ref) v_u_49, (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_48, (ref) p_u_46, (ref) v_u_45
			if not p_u_51.isLocked() then
				v_u_49:log("error", "lock was lost while loading key")

end

function v_u_39.orphanFile(p_u_60, p_u_61) -- name: orphanFile
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_8
	if v_u_3.isLargeFile(p_u_61) then
		local v_u_62 = p_u_60.ctx.logger:extend({
			["method"] = "orphanFile",
			["key"] = nil,
			["shard"] = nil,
			["key"] = p_u_60.key,
			["shard"] = p_u_61.shard
		})
		v_u_62:log("trace", "adding file to orphaned list", {
			["file"] = p_u_61
		})
		local v63 = p_u_60.orphanedFiles
		table.insert(v63, p_u_61)
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_60, (copy) v_u_62, (copy) p_u_61, (ref) v_u_11, (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_8
			while true do
				local v64 = p_u_60.ctx.dataStoreService:GetRequestBudgetForRequestType(Enum.DataStoreRequestType.SetIncrementAsync)
				if v64 >= 100 then
					break
				end
				v_u_62:log("debug", "insufficient budget for orphan cleanup, waiting", {
					["curBudget"] = nil,
					["minBudget"] = 100,
					["curBudget"] = v64
				})
				task.wait(1)
			end
			v_u_62:log("debug", "sufficient budget, processing orphaned file")
			local v65 = {}
			for v_u_66 = 1, p_u_61.count do
				v_u_62:log("trace", (("Queueing removal of shard %* of %*"):format(v_u_66, p_u_61.count)))
				local v67 = v_u_11
				local function v68()
					-- upvalues: (ref) p_u_60, (ref) p_u_61, (copy) v_u_66
					return p_u_60.ctx.shardStore:RemoveAsync((("%*-%*"):format(p_u_61.shard, v_u_66)))
				end
				table.insert(v65, v67(v68))
			end
			v_u_7.all(v65):andThen(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_62, (ref) p_u_60, (ref) v_u_8, (ref) p_u_61
				v_u_62:log("trace", "successfully removed all shards for orphaned file")
				for v69, v70 in p_u_60.orphanedFiles do
					if not v_u_8.equalsDeep(p_u_61, v70) then
						continue
					end
					table.remove(p_u_60.orphanedFiles, v69)
					return
				end
			end):catch(function(p71)
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_62
				v_u_62:log("error", (("failed to remove shards for orphaned file: %*"):format(p71)))
			end):finally(function()
				-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_62
				v_u_62:log("trace", "finished processing orphaned file task")
			end)
		end)
	end
end

function v_u_39.startAutosaving(p_u_92) -- name: startAutosaving
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2
	local v_u_93 = p_u_92.logger:extend({
		["method"] = "startAutosaving"
	})
	if p_u_92._cleanupAutosave then
		v_u_93:log("warn", "autosave already started")
		return
	elseif p_u_92.closed then
		v_u_93:log("warn", "Session is closed, not starting autosave")
	else
		v_u_93:log("trace", "starting autosave loop")
		local v_u_94 = false
		task.spawn(function()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_2, (copy) p_u_92, (ref) v_u_94, (copy) v_u_93
			while true do
				task.wait(v_u_2.AUTOSAVE_INTERVAL_SECONDS)
				if p_u_92.closed or v_u_94 then
					break
				end
				v_u_93:log("trace", "autosave triggered")
				local v95, v96 = p_u_92:save():await()
				if v95 then
					v_u_93:log("trace", "autosave completed successfully")
				else
					v_u_93:log("warn", "failed to autosave key", {
						["error"] = v96
					})
				end
			end
			v_u_93:log("trace", "autosave loop stopping", {
				["closed"] = p_u_92.closed,
				["stop"] = v_u_94
			})
		end)
		function p_u_92._cleanupAutosave()
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_93, (ref) v_u_94, (copy) p_u_92
			v_u_93:log("trace", "cleanup function called, signaling autosave loop to stop")
			v_u_94 = true
			p_u_92._cleanupAutosave = nil
		end
	end
end
function v_u_39.stopAutosaving(p97) -- name: stopAutosaving

		p97.logger:log("trace", "stopping autosave loop")
		p97._cleanupAutosave()
	else
		p97.logger:log("trace", "autosave loop not running or already stopped")
	end
end
function v_u_39.unload(p_u_98) -- name: unload
	local v_u_99 = p_u_98.logger:extend({
		["method"] = "unload"
	})
	v_u_99:log("trace", "unload called")
	if p_u_98.unloadPromise then
		v_u_99:log("trace", "unload already in progress, returning existing promise")
		return p_u_98.unloadPromise
	end
	p_u_98.closed = true
	p_u_98:stopAutosaving()
	v_u_99:log("trace", "queueing final save and lock release")
	p_u_98.unloadPromise = p_u_98.queue:add(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_99, (copy) p_u_98
		v_u_99:log("trace", "performing final updateRecord before unloading")
		return p_u_98:updateRecord()
	end):andThenReturn(nil):finally(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_99, (copy) p_u_98
		v_u_99:log("trace", "releasing lock as part of unload")
		return p_u_98.lockHandle.release():catch(function(p100)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_99
			v_u_99:log("warn", "failed to release lock during unload", {
				["error"] = p100
			})
		end)
	end)
	return p_u_98.unloadPromise
end

local function v_u_116(p_u_102, p_u_103, p_u_104, p_u_105) -- name: updateInternal
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_12
	return v_u_7.new(function(p106, p107)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_102, (copy) p_u_105, (copy) p_u_104, (ref) v_u_8, (ref) v_u_12, (copy) p_u_103
		if p_u_102.txLockPromise ~= nil then
			p_u_105:log("trace", "waiting for txLockPromise to resolve")
			p_u_102.txLockPromise:await()
			if not p_u_102.closed then
				continue
			end
			p_u_105:log("warn", "Session closed while waiting for txLockPromise, rejecting update")
			return p107("Session is closed")
		end
		p_u_105:log("trace", "txLockPromise resolved or was nil, proceeding with update")
		local v108 = p_u_102.data
		local v109
		if p_u_104 then
			v109 = p_u_102.data
		else
			v109 = v_u_8.copyDeep(p_u_102.data)
		end
		local v110 = v_u_12
		local v111 = p_u_103
		local v112, v113 = pcall(v110, v111, v109)
		if not v112 then
			p_u_105:log("error", "transformFunction errored", {
				["error"] = v113
			})
			return p107((("transformFunction failed: %*"):format(v113)))
		end
		if p_u_104 == false then
			if typeof(v113) ~= "boolean" then
				p_u_105:log("error", "transformFunction did not return a boolean")
				return p107("transformFunction must return a boolean")
			end
		elseif typeof(v113) ~= "table" and v113 ~= false then
			p_u_105:log("error", "transformFunction returned a boolean when it should return data or false")
			return p107("transformFunction must return data or false")
		end
		if v113 == false then
			p_u_105:log("trace", "transformFunction returned false, update aborted")
			return p106(false)
		end
		if not p_u_104 then
			v113 = v109

function v_u_44.prototype._reject(p_u_354, ...) -- name: _reject

function v_u_44.prototype._finalize(p366) -- name: _finalize
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_44
	for _, v367 in ipairs(p366._queuedFinally) do
		coroutine.wrap(v367)(p366._status)
	end
	p366._queuedFinally = nil
	p366._queuedReject = nil
	p366._queuedResolve = nil
	if not v_u_44.TEST then
		p366._parent = nil
		p366._consumers = nil
	end
